repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-voicea
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.voicea (required by the webex package and used by plugin-meetings). It is a factory: createChannel(llmChannel?) returns a VoiceaChannel per meeting, which borrows a caller-owned LLM data channel. A channel PUTs Locus controls to turn captions, transcription, and manual captions on and to set the spoken language; announces the client to the voicea service, requests caption languages, sends manual captions, and manages the transcription subchannel over the LLM channel; re-emits inbound relay events as voicea:* and aibridge:* events; and rebinds to another LLM channel while restoring captions. It stores nothing and owns no connection.

voicea-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js, types is dist/types/index.d.ts, and devMain names src/index.js although the entry is src/index.ts. Importing it registers VoiceaPlugin as internal plugin 'voicea' with empty options; the first registration of the name wins. Exports: default and named VoiceaPlugin, VoiceaChannel, EVENT_TRIGGERS, TURN_ON_CAPTION_STATUS, and the types MeetingTranscriptPayload and SpeakerNameUpdatePayload. webex.internal.voicea.createChannel(llmChannel?) returns a VoiceaChannel; its methods and the voicea:* and aibridge:newManualCaption events are specified in src/docs/README.md.

locus-controls.source: Locus controls endpoint (<locusUrl>/controls/, where locusUrl comes from the bound LLM channel; route definitions are not in this repository)
locus-controls.summary: PUT bodies: {transcribe: {caption: true}, languageCode}; {transcribe: {transcribing}, spokenLanguage}; {transcribe: {spokenLanguage, languageAssignment?}}; {manualCaption: {enable}}. Sent through webex.request.

voicea-relay-data-channel.source: Voicea service and AI bridge relay over the LLM data channel (relay types in src/constants.ts; service definitions are not in this repository)
voicea-relay-data-channel.summary: Outbound publishRequest frames with relayType client.annc (clientPayload version v2), voicea.transl.req, and client.manual_transcription, plus subchannelSubscriptionRequest; id is the shared sequence number and trackingId is <trackingIdPrefix>_<uuid>. Inbound relay events voicea.annc, voicea.transl.rsp, voicea.transcription, voicea.update_speakername, aibridge.manual_transcription, and client.manual_transcription.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin (first-wins, no proxies) registers the factory; WebexPlugin supplies webex and request, which createChannel binds into each channel; the named config export supplies trackingIdPrefix (default webex-js-sdk) for outbound frames.

internal-plugin-llm-channel.source: @webex/internal-plugin-llm LLMChannel (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-llm/src/docs/README.md, found stale on the plugin shape; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-llm/src/llm-plugin.ts and src/llm.ts)
internal-plugin-llm-channel.summary: Imported only as a type. The caller supplies a caller-owned LLMChannel from webex.internal.llm.createChannel(); voicea uses isConnected, getSocket().send, getBinding, getLocusUrl, getDatachannelUrl, isDataChannelTokenEnabled, and on, once, and off for event:relay.event and online.

internal-plugin-mercury-events.source: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury (workspace package, reached through LLMChannel; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md)
internal-plugin-mercury-events.summary: LLMChannel connects on the default session, whose events carry no suffix, so inbound relay frames arrive as event:relay.event and connection as online. Declared in package.json dependencies but imported only by the unit specs.

uuid.summary: uuid.v4 generates trackingId suffixes, translation-request ids, and manual-caption ids.
